name: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited
summary: Xi'an International Medical Investment Company Limited, an organization headquartered in Xi'an, China, specializes in delivering a comprehensive range of medical services. The company achieves this through the management and operation of its various hospitals and medical centers. Established in 1956, the firm underwent a name change in January 2015, transitioning from its former designation, Xi'an Kaiyuan Investment Group Co., Ltd., to its present identity.
